cases.question: RFC 8259: which encoding MUST be used for JSON text exchanged between systems outside a closed ecosystem?
gold_aspects: JSON text exchanged between systems not part of closed ecosystem MUST be UTF-8.

cases.question: RFC 8259: MAY или MUST NOT JSON parser принимать non-JSON forms or extensions?
gold_aspects: A JSON parser MAY accept non-JSON forms or extensions.

cases.question: RFC 8259: may an implementation set limits on the range and precision of numbers?
gold_aspects: An implementation may set limits on range/precision of numbers.
